{{Quote|<nowiki>SIS surveillance = cleared Senator Sydia's name // Imperial traitor = Sydia's husband // Husband = arrested this morning</nowiki>|T7-O1|<ref name="The Truth Comes Out" />}}
The '''husband''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Verre Sydia]] was a deep-cover [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] through their [[Marriage/Legends|wife's]] career during the [[Great Galactic War|Great Galactic]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold Wars]] until their true allegiances were exposed by the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Verre Sydia]], a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], as part of their role as a deep-cover [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War|Great Galactic]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold Wars]].<ref name="The Truth Comes Out" /> In [[3663 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}} Subtracting 20 years from 3,643 BBY results in a date of 3663 BBY and subtracting 10 years results in a date of 3653 BBY.</ref> an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] and fellow Imperial operative named [[Eckhorn Baliss]] added Sydia's husband to a list of potential Imperial sympathizers,<ref name="Eckhorn's List">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Eckhorn's List}}</ref> and the [[Gender/Legends|man]] feared that their cover had been blown.<ref name="The Truth Comes Out" /> Using their wife's access to classified [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] accounts,<ref name="The Senator's Secret">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|The Senator's Secret}}</ref> Sydia's husband hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Terrin Sandafar]] to kill Baliss by rigging [[Eckhorn Baliss' ship|his ship]] to explode above the noble's [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Terrin Sandafar">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Terrin Sandafar}}</ref>

However, in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the former [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Shafu]] began investigating Baliss' [[Death/Legends|death]] as part of an assignment for the deceased [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]]. Sydia's husband employed Sandafar again to eliminate the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Shafu above the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]],<ref name="Slaver's Redemption">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Slaver's Redemption}}</ref> and after killing Sandafar to eliminate their accomplice, the man's cover remained in place for another [[Time/Legends|decade]] before the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] worked with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[T7-O1]]&mdash;Shafu's former partner&mdash;to expose them. Thanks to their investigations, the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]], the Republic intelligence agency, arrested Sydia's husband.<ref name="The Truth Comes Out" />

==Behind the scenes==
Verre Sydia's husband was mentioned in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Truth Comes Out" />
